description: This module supports retrieving resource tags from ManageIQ.

parameters.name: ca_cert
parameters.description: The path to a CA bundle file or directory with certificates.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: ManageIQ password. MIQ_PASSWORD environment variable if set. Otherwise, required if no token is passed in.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: ManageIQ token. MIQ_TOKEN environment variable if set. Otherwise, required if no username or password is passed in.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: ManageIQ environment URL. MIQ_URL environment variable if set. Otherwise, it is required to pass it.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: ManageIQ username. MIQ_USERNAME environment variable if set. Otherwise, required if no token is passed in.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether SSL certificates should be verified for HTTPS requests. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: The ID of the resource at which tags are controlled. Must be specified if resource_name is not set. Both options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: resource_name
parameters.description: The name of the resource at which tags are controlled. Must be specified if resource_id is not set. Both options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: The relevant resource type in ManageIQ. Choices: "provider" "host" "vm" "blueprint" "category" "cluster" "data store" "group" "resource pool" "service" "service template" "template" "tenant" "user"

examples:
- name: List current tags for a provider in ManageIQ.
  community.general.manageiq_tags_info:
    resource_name: 'EngLab'
    resource_type: 'provider'
    manageiq_connection:
      url: 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
      username: 'admin'
      password: 'smartvm'
  register: result

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: List of tags associated with the resource. Returned: on success
